purpose: Decide whether the lean session and batched interpretation/grading can replace one-call-per-item Codex evaluation without changing results.

reference.run: #313 segment_language, individual native calls (docs/evaluations/comprehension-2.11.1/313/comprehension, copied to reference-313/ with sha256 in reference-313.sha256)

fixed_settings.model: gpt-6.1-sol (same as reference so that only the transport changes)
fixed_settings.interpret_grouping: same arm only; order shuffled with seed 364; opaque task labels
fixed_settings.grade_rules: identical per-case grade requests as the reference runner (blind labels, rubric text, quote rule), combined with build_grade_batch
fixed_settings.quote_verification: per case against that case's own responses; a failing case is re-graded once alone with the reference retry message; still failing = ungraded
fixed_settings.failed_batch: a batch whose answer cannot be split is retried once; still failing = run incomplete

stages.G_grading_only: Batched lean grading of the reference's stored first responses.
stages.I_full_pipeline: Batched lean interpretation of the reference's exact model-visible inputs, then batched lean grading.

acceptance.G1: criterion-level agreement (case, arm, criterion) with reference grades >= 0.95
acceptance.I2: per-arm whole-task pass count within +-5 of the reference over all 88 cases
acceptance.direction: in both stages the paired C vs D1 comparison keeps the reference direction (D-only > C-only)
acceptance.decision: the frozen #313 rule applied to each stage is reported next to the reference decision; a difference is explained (the reference REJECT rests on a 2-case margin)
acceptance.tokens: raw Codex tokens per case of stage I (interpretation + grading) at least 70% below the reference (<= 18,960)

fallback: If G fails: grade batch 2, else individual lean grading. If I1/I2/direction fail while G passes: keep interpretation one call per item (lean session) and batch grading only, then recompute the token reduction. No threshold is changed after seeing results.
limitations: No test-retest run of the individual method exists; part of any disagreement is ordinary run-to-run variation, so the thresholds are conservative.
Interpreter and grader are the same model family.
Validated on one candidate's case set; other task families should re-check agreement on a small sample when first run batched.
